35-30-01A.t: Portable Oxygen Unit (non-required units inoperative or missing)
35-30-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      A supply of portable oxygen must be provided for 2 % of the occupant (passengers + cabin crew)
      for the entire flight after cabin depressurization at cabin pressure altitudes above 8,000 feet.
      The quantity of oxygen required is based upon an average flow rate of 3 liters per minute per
      person and dependent upon the flight route and the real passengers in aircraft.
      The number of minimum required oxygen bottle is limited by minimum cabin crew (Refer to
      Operations Specifications A003)
      [Required oxygen quantity]
      2% Occupant (Passengers + Cabin Crew) X Dispatching Hour X 60 Min X 3 Liter/Min
      • Dispatching Hour: Dispatching hour is from cabin depressurization to airport arrival as follows
        (Refer to FOM Chapter 5.13 EDTO)
                  Route with 120min EDTO                                                   2 hours
                   Route with Non-EDTO                                                     1 hour

         Note:      Selection of dispatching hour will be determined by flight plan.
      • Only 11 cu.ft (311 Liters) quantity oxygen bottles installed.
      • Calculation Method
        In case of 186 occupants(182 Passengers + 4 Cabin Crew) with two dispatching hours(120min
        EDTO), five(5) serviceable bottles are required. 0.02 X 186 persons X 2 hours X 60 min X 3
        liters/min = 1339.2 liters (1339.2 liters ÷ 311 liters = 4.306 bottles)

        (passenger + cabin crew)

                44 ~ 86                                        4                                          4
               87 ~ 129                                        4                                          4
               130 ~ 172                                       4                                          4
               173 ~ 204                                       4                                          5

 FLIGHT CREW

   confirmation.
   Ensure that the required distribution of the oxygen units is maintained throughout the cabin, (one

   oxygen units.
